fact: A World Bank project paper dated 18 March 2026 states DGID's land system (SGF) remains incomplete and not yet interoperable with the municipal SIFCOM, with parcels registered in SIFCOM rising from 47,600 in December 2024 to 469,465 in December 2025, while land information stays largely paper-based elsewhere.
title: Project Paper on a Proposed Additional Credit to the Republic of Senegal for Senegal Cadastre and Land Tenure Improvement Project
